title: shortcut
style: field-note illustration: loose ink linework over watercolour washes on warm off-white paper, muted earth palette, soft daylight from the left, no outlines on the background

shots.panel: wide shot of an open-plan office at mid-morning. Sara sits at a cluttered desk in a rust-red cable-knit sweater, laptop open, a paper cup beside the keyboard. Khalid stands two desks away with his back half-turned.
shots.action: Sara stops typing and lifts her gaze from the screen toward Khalid

sound.ambience: low open-plan hum, a distant printer cycling, one keyboard still typing off-screen

shots.panel: medium two-shot. Sara has half-risen from her chair, one hand still on the desk. Khalid has turned fully to face her, eyebrows raised.
shots.action: Khalid turns to face her and takes one step closer to the desk

sound.ambience: the office hum drops as the typing stops

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.line: Come look at this before you push it.

shots.panel: over-the-shoulder close shot of the laptop screen from behind both of them, the screen itself abstract and unreadable, their two silhouettes framing it.
shots.action: Both lean in toward the screen; Khalid rests one hand on the back of her chair

sound.ambience: close room tone, one chair creak, a shirt sleeve brushing fabric
sound.music: a single sustained low string note entering under the last second

shots.panel: the same over-the-shoulder framing, held: the two silhouettes now still and close together, the screen glow on their faces.
